notes.title: Patch v1.3 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys Nate here!

As you may have noticed, patch v1.3 is finally here!

This patch includes some vigorous performance optimizations as we are trying to have the game run great for as many people as possible!

We are fully aware that some of you are still unable to play it and your patience has been very much appreciated!

With this patch the game will use less background resources!

There were also some game play adjustments, nothing monumental but some more aids for new players.

As always if you are still having issues with 123 SMS please let us know! Reach out to us via our website, or post in the discussions boards here! We would love to hear from you, and get you playing SMS as soon as possible!

You guys have been more than awesome and we hope to continue to terrify you! Thank you so much for all of the awesome support!

-Nate

notes.title: Patch v1.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys Nate here!

I just finished rolling out 123 Slaughter Me Street v1.2!

Version 1.2 includes some optimizations and some general smoothing over of some game elements, some based on feedback others for better performance. We are dedicated to bringing you the user the best possible experience!

Version 1.2 includes the following:

-Optimized loading! Getting into levels should be much smoother and quicker now.

-We decided a more gradual easing in of player learning should be addressed, therefore the first few floors are now much kinder.

-The flashlight. Oh yes the flashlight! It was optimized as well as made kinder. This seemed to be a primary concern with a lot of new players and we felt it was something that should be addressed. Don't worry it still breaks, but we added some more duct tape.

Like usual, if you have any bugs to report or other issues with the game, please contact us before you slam the game, we would love to find a solution for you!

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Patch v1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys Nate here!

The first update for 123 Slaughter Me Street is complete! And I am hoping for the most part that it gets rid of all of the crashing upon boot up fixed.

Please let me know if you are still unable to play the game!

If after installing the update you are still having issues I compiled a check list for you!

Also sorry it took this long, I have been at my desk since the game came out grinding away on a solution for the past 48 hours. I am only one person and this is my first time on Steam, so thank you for being so patient!

Like I said above, if you are still unable to play the game after this update here is a check list:

-Is your video card up to date?

-What version of Direct X are you using? If possible update.

-Have you tried other Quality selections from the start up dialog?

-What version of .NET framework are you running? If possible update.

-Finally, have you checked the minimum requirements for this game? This is not a very light running game, but it is also not very resource intense if you have a strong PC.

I hope this update gets more of you playing the 123 Slaughter Me Street!

Sorry again for the pain in the butt!

If you have any issues, please please please do not blindly leave a nasty comment, tell me your issue, I would love to help you out!

notes.title: Windows 8.1 Issue
notes.notes:
Hey guys Nate here!

We are experiencing some issues with the game starting on Windows 8.1, I am working to address this issue tirelessly, I have been since it was discovered last night.

Sorry for this big pain in the butt for you Windows 8 players. If you are using Windows 8 and it is running fine, I would love to hear from you, that will help me isolate the issue further!

Thank you so much for all of your support so far! You have been truly awesome!
